attributes.name: blackout_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why this period is designated as a blackout date (e.g., Major Convention, Peak Holiday Demand, Special Event). Null if not a blackout period.

attributes.name: cancellation_rate_pct
attributes.description: Historical cancellation rate for reservations during this seasonal period expressed as a percentage. Used for overbooking strategy and revenue forecasting.

attributes.name: climate_description
attributes.description: Description of typical weather and climate conditions during this seasonal period (e.g., Warm and Sunny, Rainy Season, Snow Season, Hurricane Risk). Used for guest communication and operational planning.

attributes.name: competitive_set_position
attributes.description: Property's expected market position relative to its STR competitive set during this seasonal period. Values: leader (outperforming), competitive (at par), lagging (underperforming), premium (high-end positioning), value (budget positioning).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this seasonal calendar entry was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: demand_classification
attributes.description: Categorization of expected demand level during this seasonal period. Drives pricing strategy, staffing models, and inventory controls. Values: peak (high demand), shoulder (moderate demand), off-peak (low demand), super-peak (exceptional demand). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: peak|shoulder|off-peak|super-peak|low|moderate|high — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Last date of the seasonal period (inclusive). Defines the conclusion of the season for rate strategy and operational planning.

attributes.name: estimated_adr
attributes.description: Forecasted Average Daily Rate for this seasonal period in the property's local currency. Used for revenue forecasting and rate strategy validation.

attributes.name: estimated_occupancy_pct
attributes.description: Forecasted occupancy rate for this seasonal period expressed as a percentage. Used for revenue forecasting, staffing planning, and inventory management. Based on historical performance and market trends.

attributes.name: estimated_revpar
attributes.description: Forecasted Revenue Per Available Room for this seasonal period in the property's local currency. Key performance indicator for revenue management strategy validation.

attributes.name: facility_closures
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of facilities or outlets that are closed during this seasonal period (e.g., Outdoor Pool, Beach Bar, Tennis Courts). Used for guest communication and operational planning.

attributes.name: holiday_name
attributes.description: Name of the holiday or special event if this is a holiday period (e.g., Christmas, New Year, Independence Day, Local Festival). Null if not a holiday period.

attributes.name: is_blackout_date
attributes.description: Indicates whether this period is designated as a blackout date for promotional rates, loyalty redemptions, or discounted packages. Used to protect revenue during high-demand periods.

attributes.name: is_holiday_period
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this seasonal period includes major holidays or special events that drive exceptional demand. Used for premium pricing and staffing adjustments.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who most recently updated this seasonal calendar entry. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this seasonal calendar entry was most recently updated. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: market_segment_focus
attributes.description: Primary market segment(s) targeted during this seasonal period (e.g., Leisure, Business, Group, MICE, FIT). Comma-separated if multiple segments. Drives marketing and sales strategy.

attributes.name: maximum_los_restriction
attributes.description: Maximum number of nights allowed for reservations during this seasonal period. Used to prevent long-stay bookings from blocking high-demand dates. Null if no maximum restriction applies.

attributes.name: minimum_los_restriction
attributes.description: Minimum number of nights required for reservations during this seasonal period. Used to optimize revenue during high-demand periods. Null if no minimum restriction applies.

attributes.name: no_show_rate_pct
attributes.description: Historical no-show rate for reservations during this seasonal period expressed as a percentage. Used for overbooking strategy and revenue optimization.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context, special considerations, or operational instructions for this seasonal period. Used for communication between revenue management, operations, and workforce teams.

attributes.name: operating_status
attributes.description: Operational mode of the property during this seasonal period. Indicates whether full services are available or if there are seasonal closures or reduced operations.

attributes.name: rate_season_code
attributes.description: Rate season identifier used by the Revenue Management System (RMS) to apply appropriate Best Available Rate (BAR) levels and dynamic pricing rules. Maps to IDeaS G3 RMS rate season configuration.

attributes.name: reduced_operating_hours
attributes.description: Description of any reduced operating hours for facilities or services during this seasonal period (e.g., Restaurant: Dinner Only, Spa: Weekends Only). Null if no reductions apply.

attributes.name: rgi_target
attributes.description: Target Revenue Generation Index for this seasonal period. RGI measures property's RevPAR performance relative to its competitive set (100 = at par, >100 = outperforming, <100 = underperforming).

attributes.name: season_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code identifying the season (e.g., PEAK_SUM, SHOULDER_SPR, OFF_WIN). Used for rate plan mapping and operational planning.

attributes.name: season_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the seasonal period (e.g., Summer Peak Season, Winter Off-Peak, Holiday Super Peak). Human-readable label for reporting and communication.

attributes.name: season_year
attributes.description: Calendar year to which this seasonal period applies. Supports year-over-year comparison and multi-year planning.

attributes.name: seasonal_calendar_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this seasonal calendar entry. Values: active (in use), draft (being planned), archived (historical), cancelled (no longer applicable).

attributes.name: seasonal_hiring_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether additional seasonal staff hiring is required for this period. Used by HR and workforce planning teams to initiate recruitment.

attributes.name: special_events
attributes.description: Description of major local or property-specific events occurring during this seasonal period that impact demand (e.g., Annual Music Festival, Marathon Weekend, Convention Center Trade Show). Null if no special events.

attributes.name: staffing_level
attributes.description: Planned staffing level for this seasonal period. Drives workforce scheduling and seasonal hiring decisions. Values: full (standard staffing), reduced (lower than standard), minimal (skeleton crew), peak-augmented (additional seasonal staff).

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: First date of the seasonal period (inclusive). Defines the beginning of the season for rate strategy and operational planning.

attributes.name: yoy_demand_trend
attributes.description: Trend classification comparing this season's expected demand to the same period in the prior year. Used for strategic planning and market positioning. Values: increasing (demand up), stable (demand flat), decreasing (demand down), volatile (unpredictable), new-season (no historical data).

attributes.name: yoy_demand_variance_pct
attributes.description: Percentage change in expected demand compared to the same seasonal period in the prior year. Positive values indicate growth, negative values indicate decline. Null for new seasons without historical data.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the revenue manager or system user who created this seasonal calendar entry. Used for audit trail and accountability.

products.name: currency
products.description: Reference master for currencies used across the global property portfolio, including ISO 4217 currency codes, currency names, decimal precision, exchange rate source configuration, and base currency designation for financial consolidation.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the currency record. Primary key.

attributes.name: base_currency_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on currency (base_currency_id)

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 alphabetic currency code (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY). This is the standard international identifier for the currency used across all financial systems, property management systems, and revenue management platforms.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166 country code for the primary country where this currency is the official legal tender (e.g., USA for USD, GBR for GBP). Used for geographic revenue analysis and Smith Travel Research (STR) market benchmarking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this currency record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and compliance with Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) requirements for financial data.

attributes.name: currency_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the currency in the system. Active currencies are available for all transactions; inactive currencies are retained for historical reporting; deprecated currencies are being phased out; historical currencies are no longer in circulation (e.g., legacy European currencies replaced by EUR); pending currencies are configured but not yet live.

attributes.name: decimal_places
attributes.description: Number of decimal places used for this currency in financial calculations and display. Most currencies use 2 (e.g., USD 100.50), some use 0 (e.g., JPY 1000), and a few use 3 (e.g., BHD 10.250). Critical for accurate revenue calculations, Average Daily Rate (ADR), and Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR) reporting.

attributes.name: display_format
attributes.description: The standard display format for this currency including symbol placement, decimal separator, and thousands separator (e.g., $1,234.56 for USD, 1.234,56 € for EUR). Used to ensure consistent presentation across guest-facing systems, reports, and Business Intelligence (BI) dashboards.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this currency configuration became or will become effective in the system. Used for managing currency transitions, redenominations, and historical accuracy in financial reporting.

attributes.name: erp_currency_code
attributes.description: The currency code or identifier used in the Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system, such as SAP S/4HANA. Used for financial consolidation, General Ledger (GL) posting, Accounts Payable (AP), and Accounts Receivable (AR) integration.

attributes.name: exchange_rate_source
attributes.description: The authoritative source or provider for exchange rate data for this currency (e.g., OANDA, XE.com, Bloomberg, Reuters, Central Bank). Used to ensure consistent exchange rate application across Central Reservation System (CRS), Revenue Management System (RMS), and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems.

attributes.name: exchange_rate_update_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which exchange rates are refreshed for this currency. Critical for accurate revenue recognition, dynamic pricing in Revenue Management System (RMS), and financial consolidation under International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP).

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this currency configuration expires or is no longer valid for new transactions. Nullable for currencies with indefinite validity. Used for managing currency transitions and ensuring historical data integrity.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this currency is currently active and available for use in transactions, reservations, and financial operations. Inactive currencies are retained for historical reporting but cannot be used for new transactions.

attributes.name: is_base_currency
attributes.description: Indicates whether this currency is the base currency for financial consolidation and corporate reporting. Typically one currency per enterprise (e.g., USD for US-headquartered companies). Used for Gross Operating Profit (GOP), Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA), and consolidated financial statements under Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry (USALI).

attributes.name: is_crypto_currency
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a cryptocurrency (e.g., Bitcoin, Ethereum) rather than a traditional fiat currency. Used for special handling in payment processing, regulatory compliance, and financial reporting.

attributes.name: minor_unit
attributes.description: The relationship between the major currency unit and its minor unit (e.g., 100 cents = 1 dollar). Defines the subdivision of the currency for precise financial calculations in Property Management System (PMS) and Point of Sale (POS) systems.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full official name of the currency (e.g., United States Dollar, Euro, British Pound Sterling, Japanese Yen). Used for display purposes in financial reports and guest-facing materials.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, special handling instructions, or contextual information about this currency. May include information about currency restrictions, regulatory requirements, or system-specific configuration details.

attributes.name: numeric_code
attributes.description: Three-digit ISO 4217 numeric currency code used in systems where alphabetic codes are not practical. Provides an alternative identifier for the currency in legacy systems and international payment processing.

attributes.name: payment_processing_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this currency is enabled for payment processing through Point of Sale (POS) systems, online booking engines, and payment gateways. Must comply with Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) requirements.

attributes.name: pms_currency_code
attributes.description: The currency code or identifier used in the Property Management System (PMS), such as Oracle OPERA. May differ from ISO 4217 code in legacy systems. Used for system integration and data mapping between PMS and enterprise data warehouse.

attributes.name: rounding_method
attributes.description: The rounding method to be applied when performing calculations with this currency. Standard follows mathematical rounding rules; up always rounds up; down always rounds down; nearest rounds to nearest value; bankers rounding (round half to even) minimizes cumulative rounding errors in large transaction volumes. Critical for accurate Average Daily Rate (ADR) and Total Revenue Per Available Room (TRevPAR) calculations.

attributes.name: symbol
attributes.description: Standard symbol used to represent the currency (e.g., $, €, £, ¥). Used in user interfaces, reports, and guest-facing displays for quick visual recognition.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this currency record was last modified. Used for change tracking, data quality monitoring, and audit compliance.

domains.name: inventory
domains.description: Real-time room inventory management including room types, physical room attributes, availability, room status, housekeeping status, out-of-order designations, and inventory controls. Manages room blocks, allotments, overbooking limits, and LRA (Last Room Availability). Integrates with PMS (Oracle OPERA) and RMS (IDeaS G3) for dynamic inventory allocation across distribution channels. Tracks OCC and supports LOS-based controls.

products.name: room_type
products.description: Master catalog of room types defined per property, including physical configuration (bed type, bed count, view category, square footage), maximum occupancy, accessibility features, ADA compliance status, connecting room eligibility, and suite classification. Serves as the foundational classification entity for all inventory management — availability, controls, blocks, allotments, channel distribution, and demand forecasting all reference room type as their primary dimension. Defined and maintained in Oracle OPERA PMS across luxury, premium, and select-service segments.

attributes.name: room_type_id
attributes.description: Primary key for room_type

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property where this room type is defined. Room types are property-specific configurations.

attributes.name: seasonal_calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.seasonal_calendar. Business justification: Revenue management: room type sellability, rate_category, and effective dates are governed by seasonal demand periods. Linking room_type to seasonal_calendar enables brand standard audits verifying ro

attributes.name: accessibility_features
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of accessibility features available in this room type. Examples: roll-in shower, grab bars, visual alarm, hearing kit, lowered fixtures. Used for guest matching and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: active_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the room type. Inactive types are not available for new reservations. Seasonal types are active only during specific periods. Renovation types are temporarily unavailable.

attributes.name: bathroom_configuration
attributes.description: Description of bathroom setup. Examples: single full bath, 1.5 bath, dual vanity, separate tub and shower. Used for guest expectations and competitive positioning.

attributes.name: bed_count
attributes.description: Number of beds in the room type. Used for occupancy calculations and guest preference matching.

attributes.name: bed_type
attributes.description: Primary bed configuration for the room type. Critical for guest preference matching and inventory allocation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: king|queen|double|twin|california_king|murphy|sofa_bed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code used to identify the room type in PMS and RMS systems. Examples: KING, QQDBL, JSUITE, PRES. This is the operational identifier used across reservations, inventory, and revenue management.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this room type record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed marketing description of the room type including amenities, features, and guest experience highlights. Used for guest-facing channels and OTA distribution.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this room type configuration expires or is replaced. Null for currently active configurations. Used for historical tracking and renovation planning.

attributes.name: effective_start_date

attributes.name: floor_level_range
attributes.description: Typical floor range where this room type is located. Examples: 1-5, 6-10, 15-20. Used for guest preference and accessibility planning.

attributes.name: is_ada_compliant

attributes.description: Indicates whether this room type meets ADA accessibility requirements including mobility, hearing, and visual accommodations. Required for compliance reporting and guest accessibility requests.

attributes.name: is_connecting_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this room type can be configured as a connecting room. Used for family and group booking allocation.

attributes.name: is_suite

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this room type record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data synchronization across PMS, RMS, and CRS systems.

attributes.name: lra_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this room type participates in Last Room Availability agreements with OTA partners. Critical for channel distribution and rate parity management.

attributes.name: max_occupancy
attributes.description: Maximum number of guests allowed in this room type per fire code and property standards. Used for reservation validation and yield optimization.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the room type as displayed to guests and staff. Examples: Deluxe King, Queen Queen Double, Junior Suite, Presidential Suite.

attributes.name: overbooking_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether this room type can be overbooked as part of revenue management strategy. Used by RMS for yield optimization.

attributes.name: pseudo_room_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a pseudo room type used for inventory management purposes (e.g., house use, out of order, complimentary) rather than a sellable room type. Used for inventory controls and reporting exclusions.

attributes.name: rate_category
attributes.description: Rate category classification used for revenue management and pricing strategy. Examples: BAR, Corporate, Government, Group, Promotional. Links to rate plan structures.

attributes.name: room_class
attributes.description: High-level classification of the room type by service tier. Used for segmentation in revenue management and guest experience programs.

attributes.name: room_features
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of key room features and amenities. Examples: balcony, kitchenette, fireplace, whirlpool, separate shower, walk-in closet. Used for guest communication and OTA distribution.

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: Property segment classification for this room type. Aligns with brand standards and service level expectations.

attributes.name: sellable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this room type is available for sale to guests. Non-sellable types include staff rooms, maintenance rooms, and owner units.

attributes.name: smoking_policy
attributes.description: Smoking policy for this room type. Most properties are non-smoking; some maintain designated smoking inventory.

attributes.name: sort_order

attributes.name: square_footage
attributes.description: Total floor area of the room type in square feet. Used for guest communication, competitive positioning, and property planning.

attributes.name: standard_occupancy
attributes.description: Standard number of guests for this room type used for base rate calculations. Additional guests may incur extra person charges.

attributes.name: view_category

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ocean|city|mountain|garden|pool|courtyard|no_view|partial — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: room_id

attributes.name: connecting_room_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the adjacent room that connects to this room via connecting door. Null if no connecting room.

attributes.name: room_type_id

attributes.name: ada_accessible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the room meets ADA accessibility standards including wheelchair access, grab bars, visual alarms, and accessible bathroom fixtures.

attributes.name: balcony_available

attributes.name: bed_count

attributes.name: bed_type

attributes.name: building_code

attributes.name: connecting_room_available

attributes.name: features

attributes.name: ffe_condition_score

attributes.name: housekeeping_status

attributes.name: kitchenette_available

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: cleaning_type
attributes.description: Type of cleaning service required or last performed. Checkout: full cleaning after guest departure; Stayover: daily service for occupied room; Deep Clean: comprehensive periodic cleaning; Turndown: evening service; Refresh: light touch-up.

attributes.name: discrepancy_flag

attributes.name: housekeeping_status

attributes.name: maintenance_status

attributes.name: occupancy_status
attributes.description: Simple binary occupancy indicator. Vacant: no guest assigned; Occupied: guest currently checked in; Reserved: future reservation exists.

attributes.name: out_of_order_end_date

attributes.name: out_of_order_reason

products.name: availability_snapshot
products.description: Date-level inventory availability record per room type per property capturing total physical rooms, rooms sold, rooms blocked (group and allotment), out-of-order rooms, out-of-service rooms, complimentary rooms, house-use rooms, day-use rooms, and net available rooms. The authoritative SSOT for real-time occupancy (OCC) calculation and available-to-sell inventory. Feeds IDeaS G3 RMS for yield optimization and supports LRA (Last Room Availability) flag tracking. Reconciled nightly during night audit against PMS folios and room status. Serves as the foundation for RevPAR, occupancy trending, and inventory reconciliation reporting.

products.name: control
products.description: Unified inventory control and restriction record defining all sell constraints per room type per stay date: sell limits, hurdle rates, minimum length-of-stay (MinLOS), maximum length-of-stay (MaxLOS), closed-to-arrival (CTA), closed-to-departure (CTD), stop-sell flags, overbooking limits (percentage and absolute), walk risk tolerance, and channel-level inventory gating rules. Generated by IDeaS G3 RMS and enforced in Oracle OPERA PMS and Sabre SynXis CRS. The single diagnostic target for answering 'why can't this room type be sold on this date?' — consolidates all restriction types into one queryable entity. Supports HTNG inventory control message standards and dynamic allocation across OTA, GDS, and direct channels.

attributes.description: Percentage point impact on property occupancy rate due to this room being out-of-order. Used for STR reporting and competitive benchmarking.

attributes.name: impact_on_revpar
attributes.business_glossary_term: Impact on Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR)
attributes.description: Calculated impact on property RevPAR due to this room being out-of-order. Critical metric for revenue management and performance analysis.

tag_set.value: Impact on Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR)

attributes.name: lost_revenue_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated revenue loss due to the room being unavailable for sale during the out-of-order period. Calculated using ADR and occupancy forecasts for RevPAR impact analysis.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, observations, or special instructions related to the out-of-order condition and repair work.

attributes.name: ooo_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the reason category for the room being out-of-order or out-of-service (e.g., MAINT, REPAIR, RENO, DAMAGE, INSPECT).

attributes.name: ooo_reason
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the specific reason the room is out-of-order or out-of-service (e.g., plumbing leak, HVAC failure, carpet replacement, pest control treatment).

attributes.name: ooo_status
attributes.description: Designation type: OOO (Out-of-Order - not counted in available inventory) or OOS (Out-of-Service - counted in inventory but not sold). Follows USALI standards for inventory accounting.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Urgency level assigned to the repair or maintenance work (Critical, High, Medium, Low). Critical priority indicates immediate revenue impact or safety concern.

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the out-of-order record (Open - newly reported, In Progress - work underway, Completed - room returned to service, Cancelled - designation reversed).

attributes.name: relocation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether guest relocation to another room or property was required due to this out-of-order condition. Used for service recovery tracking.

attributes.name: reported_by_name
attributes.description: Name of the staff member who reported the out-of-order condition for operational tracking and accountability.

attributes.name: responsible_department
attributes.description: Department responsible for addressing the issue and returning the room to service (e.g., Housekeeping, Maintenance, Engineering, Facilities, Renovation). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Housekeeping|Maintenance|Engineering|Facilities|Renovation|Pest Control|Safety|Quality Assurance — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: safety_concern_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the out-of-order condition involves a safety or health hazard requiring immediate attention per OSHA or local safety regulations.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date when the room was first designated as out-of-order or out-of-service and removed from sellable inventory.

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the room was designated as out-of-order or out-of-service, including time of day for accurate inventory impact tracking.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this out-of-order record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

products.name: los_restriction
products.description: Length-of-Stay (LOS) restriction record defining minimum LOS (MinLOS), maximum LOS (MaxLOS), and full-pattern LOS requirements per room type per stay date and rate plan. Supports LOS-based revenue optimization strategies managed in IDeaS G3 RMS and distributed via Sabre SynXis CRS. Captures restriction type, effective date range, applicable channels, and override authority.
products.reference: IDeaS G3 LOS Controls / OPERA LOS Restrictions

attributes.name: los_restriction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the length-of-stay restriction record. Primary key.

attributes.name: channel_id

attributes.name: demand_forecast_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.demand_forecast. Business justification: Revenue strategy traceability: LOS restrictions (min/max stay) are triggered by demand forecast thresholds. Linking los_restriction to the demand_forecast that triggered it enables RMS audit reporting

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the property to which this LOS restriction applies.

attributes.name: revenue_rate_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the rate plan to which this LOS restriction applies. Nullable if restriction applies to all rate plans.

attributes.name: room_type_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the room type to which this LOS restriction applies.

attributes.name: seasonal_calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.seasonal_calendar. Business justification: Revenue strategy compliance: LOS restrictions are set in response to seasonal demand patterns. The seasonal_calendar defines property-level min/max LOS targets per season. Revenue audits verify that a

attributes.name: tier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.tier. Business justification: LOS restrictions are routinely waived or modified by tier (platinum members exempt from 3-night minimums during peak demand). Revenue management systems need this to enforce tier-based restriction ove

attributes.name: adr_threshold_amount
attributes.description: ADR threshold amount that triggers or releases this LOS restriction. Used for rate-based restriction logic.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this LOS restriction record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: day_of_week_pattern
attributes.description: 7-character binary string indicating which days of the week this restriction applies to (1=applies, 0=does not apply). Format: SMTWTFS (Sunday through Saturday).

attributes.name: distribution_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this LOS restriction was last distributed to external channels via Sabre SynXis CRS or GDS connections.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The last date on which this LOS restriction is active. Null indicates an open-ended restriction.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The first date on which this LOS restriction becomes active and enforceable.

attributes.name: full_pattern_los
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of exact LOS values allowed (e.g., '3,7,14' means only 3-night, 7-night, or 14-night stays are permitted). Null if restriction type is not full_pattern.

attributes.name: group_block_exempt_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether group block reservations are exempt from this LOS restriction. True if group blocks bypass this restriction, false otherwise.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this LOS restriction record was last modified.

attributes.name: loyalty_tier_exempt_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of loyalty program tier codes that are exempt from this LOS restriction (e.g., 'PLATINUM,DIAMOND'). Null if no loyalty exemptions apply.

attributes.name: lra_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this LOS restriction applies under Last Room Availability (LRA) conditions. True if restriction is enforced even when selling the last available room, false otherwise.

attributes.name: market_segment_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the market segment to which this restriction applies (e.g., CORP, LEISURE, GROUP). Null if restriction applies to all segments.

attributes.name: max_los
attributes.description: Maximum number of nights a guest may stay when this restriction is active. Null if restriction type is not max_los.

attributes.name: min_los
attributes.description: Minimum number of nights a guest must stay when this restriction is active. Null if restriction type is not min_los.

attributes.name: occ_threshold_percent
attributes.description: Occupancy percentage threshold that triggers or releases this LOS restriction. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 85.00 for 85%).

attributes.name: override_authority_level
attributes.description: Minimum authority level required to override this LOS restriction during the reservation process: none (no override allowed), supervisor, manager, director, or general manager (GM).

attributes.name: override_reason_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a documented reason is required when this LOS restriction is overridden. True if reason is mandatory, false otherwise.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric rank indicating the priority of this restriction when multiple LOS restrictions apply to the same stay date and room type. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: restriction_code
attributes.description: Business code identifying this LOS restriction rule for operational reference and reporting.

attributes.name: restriction_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context, rationale, or special instructions for this LOS restriction. Used for operational communication and audit purposes.

attributes.name: restriction_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of this LOS restriction: active (enforced), inactive (not enforced), suspended (temporarily disabled), or pending (scheduled for future activation).

attributes.name: restriction_type
attributes.description: Type of LOS restriction: minimum LOS (MinLOS), maximum LOS (MaxLOS), full-pattern LOS requirement, closed to arrival (CTA), or closed to departure (CTD).

attributes.name: revenue_strategy_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the revenue management strategy or campaign that generated this LOS restriction (e.g., PEAK_DEMAND, SHOULDER_SEASON, EVENT_DRIVEN).

attributes.name: revpar_threshold_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR) Threshold Amount
attributes.description: RevPAR threshold amount that triggers or releases this LOS restriction. Used for dynamic restriction management based on revenue performance.

tag_set.value: Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR) Threshold Amount

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the system that created or last modified this LOS restriction: OPERA (Oracle OPERA PMS), IDEAS (IDeaS G3 RMS), SYNXIS (Sabre SynXis CRS), EZRMS (Infor EzRMS), or MANUAL (manual entry).

attributes.name: stay_date
attributes.description: The specific date for which this LOS restriction applies. Represents the arrival or stay-through date depending on restriction logic.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for the room amenity record. Primary key for the room amenity catalog.

attributes.name: parent_room_amenity_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on room_amenity (parent_room_amenity_id)

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the property where this amenity is available. Links to the property master data.

attributes.name: room_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific physical room where this amenity is installed. Null if amenity is defined at room type level only.

attributes.name: room_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.room_type. Business justification: room_amenity product description states amenities are 'available by room type and individual room'. Currently only has FK to room (room_id). Many amenities are defined at room_type level (e.g., all De

attributes.name: amenity_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the amenity type for inventory management and guest preference tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: technology|bathroom|bedding|minibar|furniture|climate_control|entertainment|connectivity — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: amenity_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the amenity type. Used for system integration and reporting consistency across properties.

attributes.name: amenity_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the amenity including brand, model, features, and guest-facing benefits. Used for marketing and guest communication.

attributes.name: amenity_name
attributes.description: Business-friendly name of the amenity as displayed to guests and staff. Examples: Smart TV, Minibar, Espresso Machine, Premium Bedding.

attributes.name: brand_name
attributes.description: Manufacturer or brand name of the amenity. Important for luxury properties where brand recognition drives guest satisfaction.

attributes.name: charge_amount
attributes.description: Price charged to guest if amenity is consumed or used. Null for complimentary amenities. Used for minibar items and premium services.

attributes.name: condition_status
attributes.description: Current physical condition of the amenity as assessed during last inspection. Drives maintenance and replacement decisions.

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the unit cost. Required when unit_cost is populated.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this amenity record was first created in the system. Used for audit trails and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the charge amount. Required when charge_amount is populated.

attributes.name: display_sequence
attributes.description: Sort order for displaying amenities in guest-facing interfaces and reports. Lower numbers appear first.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this amenity configuration is no longer active. Null indicates no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this amenity configuration becomes active and available for guest use or booking display.

attributes.name: guest_visible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amenity is displayed in guest-facing channels such as booking engines, mobile apps, and property websites. Used for marketing and distribution.

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date when the amenity was installed or placed in the room. Used for tracking asset age and planning replacement cycles.

attributes.name: is_ada_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) Compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the amenity meets ADA accessibility requirements. Critical for compliance and guest accommodation matching.

tag_set.value: Is ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) Compliant

attributes.name: is_complimentary
attributes.description: Indicates whether the amenity is provided at no additional charge to the guest. False indicates a chargeable amenity such as minibar items.

attributes.name: is_eco_friendly
attributes.description: Indicates whether the amenity meets environmental sustainability standards. Used for green certification programs and guest preference matching.

attributes.name: is_premium_amenity
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amenity is considered a premium or luxury feature that differentiates the room type and justifies higher ADR (Average Daily Rate).

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent inspection or condition assessment of the amenity. Critical for quality assurance and guest satisfaction.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this amenity record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking and synchronization.

attributes.name: maintenance_frequency_days
attributes.description: Number of days between scheduled maintenance or inspection cycles for this amenity. Used for preventive maintenance scheduling.

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer model number or SKU for the amenity. Used for procurement, warranty tracking, and replacement ordering.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_replacement_date
attributes.description: Planned date for replacing or refreshing the amenity based on lifecycle policy. Supports proactive FF&E capital planning.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational availability of the amenity. Inactive or out_of_service amenities are not available to guests.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Purchase order reference number for the amenity acquisition. Used for financial reconciliation and audit trails.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Number of units of this amenity present in the room or room type. Example: 2 for pillows, 1 for minibar.

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, handling instructions, or guest communication guidelines related to the amenity.

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Acquisition cost per unit of the amenity. Used for CapEx (Capital Expenditure) tracking and ROI (Return on Investment) analysis.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit in which the amenity quantity is measured. Used for inventory tracking and replenishment.

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when manufacturer warranty coverage expires. Important for cost planning and vendor relationship management.

domains.name: revenue
domains.description: Authoritative source for pricing strategies, rate plans, yield optimization, and revenue performance. Manages BAR (Best Available Rate), dynamic pricing rules, DRR (Dynamic Rate Rules), rate restrictions, demand forecasting, and competitive benchmarking (STR STAR Report, RGI, MPI, ARI). Tracks ADR, RevPAR, TRevPAR, and GOPPAR metrics. Integrates with IDeaS G3 RMS and Infor EzRMS.

products.name: revenue_rate_plan
products.description: Master catalog of all rate plans available across properties, including BAR (Best Available Rate), LRA (Last Room Availability), NRR (Non-Refundable Rate), corporate negotiated rates, package rates, and promotional rates. Defines rate structure, cancellation policy, meal plan inclusions, booking conditions, and distribution eligibility. Sourced from IDeaS G3 RMS and Sabre SynXis CRS. This is the SSOT for rate plan definitions.

attributes.name: revenue_rate_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each rate plan record in the revenue management system. Primary key for the revenue_rate_plan data product. Role: MASTER_RESOURCE.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.franchise_agreement. Linking revenue_rate_plan to franchise_agreement enables

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fnb.revenue_center. Business justification: Rate plans with F&B inclusions (resort credits, meal plans) are scoped to a specific revenue center (e.g., pool bar only, main restaurant only). revenue_rate_plan links to fnb_outlet and menu but not

attributes.name: loyalty_tier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.tier. Business justification: Rate plans enforce tier-specific eligibility (loyalty_tier_required field exists). Business process: validating member tier qualification for rate plan access at booking time. Essential for tier-based

attributes.name: market_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.market_segment. Business justification: Revenue rate plans are designed for specific market segments — the market_segment_code on revenue_rate_plan is a denormalized reference to the market_segment master. Adding market_segment_id normalize

attributes.name: meeting_space_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.meeting_space. Business justification: Meeting space rental rate plans are a distinct revenue management discipline. Linking revenue_rate_plan to meeting_space enables space-specific pricing (by capacity, AV equipment, rental tier), minimu

attributes.name: promotion_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.promotion. Business justification: Promotional rate plans (e.g., a 'Stay 3 Pay 2' rate plan tied to a loyalty bonus-points promotion) require a direct rate-plan-to-promotion link for correct points multiplier application, promotion eli

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property or hotel at which this rate plan is applicable. Enables property-level rate plan management across a multi-property portfolio. A null value indicates a chain-wide or global rate plan applicable to all properties.

attributes.name: room_type_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific room type or room category to which this rate plan applies. A null value indicates the rate plan applies to all room types at the associated property.

attributes.name: advance_purchase_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days prior to arrival that a booking must be made to qualify for this rate plan. Common values are 7, 14, 21, or 30 days for advance purchase promotional rates. A value of 0 indicates no advance purchase requirement.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the revenue manager or director who approved this rate plan for distribution. Supports SOX financial controls and internal audit requirements for rate authorization governance.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this rate plan was formally approved for activation and distribution. Distinct from created_timestamp; captures the authorization event in the rate plan lifecycle. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: base_rate_amount
attributes.description: The principal nightly room rate amount in the operating currency before any adjustments, taxes, or fees. Represents the rack rate or floor price for this rate plan. Used as the reference value for ADR (Average Daily Rate) and RevPAR (Revenue Per Available Room) calculations. Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE MEASUREMENT_OR_VALUE category.

attributes.name: booking_window_close_date
attributes.description: The last date on which new reservations can be made under this rate plan. After this date the rate plan is closed to new bookings even if the stay dates fall within the effective period.

attributes.name: booking_window_open_date
attributes.description: The earliest date on which reservations can be made under this rate plan. Used to control promotional rate availability windows and prevent premature booking of seasonal or event-driven rates.

attributes.name: cancellation_policy_code
attributes.description: Code referencing the cancellation and penalty policy associated with this rate plan (e.g., FLEX24H, NRR_NOREF, 48H_PENALTY). Determines guest refund eligibility and penalty charges upon cancellation. Critical for NRR (Non-Refundable Rate) and advance purchase rate plans.

attributes.name: commission_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of the room rate payable as commission to the booking agent or OTA when is_commissionable is true. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 10.00 for 10%). Null when is_commissionable is false.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this rate plan record was first created in the source system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: discount_pct
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied to the BAR (Best Available Rate) or rack rate to derive this rate plan's selling price. Used for corporate negotiated rates, loyalty member rates, and promotional rates. A value of 0 indicates no discount from the reference rate.

attributes.name: drr_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate plan is subject to DRR (Dynamic Rate Rule) adjustments by the revenue management system. When true, IDeaS G3 RMS or Infor EzRMS may automatically adjust the rate based on demand forecasts, occupancy levels, and competitive benchmarking.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The calendar date from which this rate plan becomes active and bookable. Used by IDeaS G3 RMS and Sabre SynXis CRS to control rate availability windows. Satisfies MASTER_AGREEMENT EFFECTIVE_FROM category.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The calendar date after which this rate plan is no longer available for new bookings. Null indicates an open-ended rate plan with no defined end date. Satisfies MASTER_AGREEMENT EFFECTIVE_UNTIL category.

attributes.name: gds_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate plan is distributed through GDS (Global Distribution System) channels such as Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport. Controls rate visibility to travel agents using GDS booking tools.

attributes.name: is_commissionable
attributes.description: Indicates whether a travel agent or OTA (Online Travel Agency) commission is payable on bookings made under this rate plan. Drives commission accrual and payment processing in SAP S/4HANA AP.

attributes.name: is_lra_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate plan carries LRA (Last Room Availability) obligation, meaning the contracted rate must be honored even when only the last room in a category is available. Applicable to corporate negotiated rate contracts.

attributes.name: is_refundable
attributes.description: Indicates whether bookings under this rate plan are eligible for a full refund upon cancellation within the policy window. False for NRR (Non-Refundable Rate) plans; true for flexible BAR (Best Available Rate) plans.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this rate plan record was most recently updated in the source system. Used to detect changes for incremental ETL processing and audit compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether stays booked under this rate plan qualify for loyalty program points accrual. Wholesale, opaque, and certain promotional rates are typically ineligible for points earning.

attributes.name: loyalty_tier_required
attributes.description: Minimum loyalty program membership tier required to access this rate plan. A value of 'none' indicates the rate is open to all guests regardless of loyalty status. Used to gate exclusive member rates.

attributes.name: max_los
attributes.description: Maximum number of nights permitted under this rate plan. Used to prevent extended stays at promotional or deeply discounted rates. A null value indicates no maximum stay restriction.

attributes.name: meal_plan_type
attributes.description: Indicates the F&B (Food and Beverage) inclusions bundled with this rate plan. Room only includes no meals; bed and breakfast includes morning meal; half board includes breakfast and dinner; full board includes all three meals; all-inclusive covers meals, beverages, and selected activities.

attributes.name: min_los
attributes.description: Minimum number of nights a guest must book to qualify for this rate plan. A LOS (Length of Stay) restriction used in yield optimization to drive longer stays during high-demand periods. A value of 1 indicates no minimum stay restriction.

attributes.name: ota_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate plan is distributed through OTA (Online Travel Agency) channels such as Booking.com, Expedia, or Agoda. Controls rate visibility on third-party booking platforms.

attributes.name: rate_category
attributes.description: Secondary classification grouping rate plans by the market segment or distribution channel they serve. Public rates are available to all guests; negotiated rates are contracted with specific accounts; wholesale rates are sold through tour operators; group rates apply to block bookings; loyalty rates are exclusive to program members; employee rates are internal staff benefits.

attributes.name: rate_ceiling_amount
attributes.description: The maximum rate above which this rate plan cannot be sold, used to cap pricing during peak demand periods for contracted or promotional rates. Null indicates no ceiling constraint.

attributes.name: rate_floor_amount
attributes.description: The minimum rate below which this rate plan cannot be sold, regardless of dynamic pricing adjustments. Protects rate integrity and brand positioning. Used by IDeaS G3 RMS as a hard constraint in yield optimization algorithms.

attributes.name: rate_level
attributes.description: Indicates the organizational scope at which this rate plan is defined and managed. Property-level plans apply to a single hotel; brand-level plans apply across a brand portfolio; chain-level plans apply across the entire company; global plans may span international markets.

attributes.name: rate_plan_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the rate plan across systems (e.g., BAR, CORP001, PKG-SPA). Used as the business key in IDeaS G3 RMS, Sabre SynXis CRS, and Oracle OPERA PMS for rate plan lookup and distribution. Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category.

attributes.name: rate_plan_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the rate plan's terms, inclusions, and conditions as displayed to guests and booking agents. Includes details on what is included in the rate, any special conditions, and marketing messaging.

attributes.name: rate_plan_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the rate plan displayed to guests and revenue managers (e.g., 'Best Available Rate', 'AAA Member Rate', 'Advance Purchase 21-Day'). Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE IDENTITY_LABEL category.

attributes.name: rate_plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rate plan by its commercial structure. BAR (Best Available Rate) is the publicly available flexible rate; LRA (Last Room Availability) guarantees availability to contracted accounts; NRR (Non-Refundable Rate) carries no cancellation flexibility; corporate rates are negotiated with companies; package rates bundle room with ancillary services; promotional rates are time-limited offers. Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE category.

attributes.name: rate_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the rate plan. Active plans are available for booking; inactive plans are temporarily disabled; draft plans are under configuration; suspended plans are paused due to yield or compliance review; archived plans are retired and no longer bookable. Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE LIFECYCLE_STATUS category.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this rate plan record was sourced. Enables data lineage tracking and conflict resolution when the same rate plan exists in multiple systems.

attributes.name: source_system_rate_reference
attributes.description: The native identifier of this rate plan in the originating operational system (IDeaS G3 RMS, Sabre SynXis CRS, or Oracle OPERA PMS). Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse Silver layer and the system of record.

attributes.name: stay_date_restriction
attributes.description: Defines any day-of-week or date-specific restrictions on when stays under this rate plan are permitted. Weekday-only and weekend-only restrictions are common for corporate and leisure rates respectively; blackout dates exclude specific high-demand periods.

attributes.name: tax_inclusive
attributes.description: Indicates whether the base_rate_amount includes applicable taxes (VAT, occupancy tax, city tax). True for tax-inclusive markets; false for markets where taxes are added at checkout. Critical for accurate revenue recognition under USALI and IFRS/GAAP.

products.name: rate_restriction
products.description: Operational records of rate restrictions applied to rate plans and room types, including minimum LOS (Length of Stay), maximum LOS, closed-to-arrival (CTA), closed-to-departure (CTD), advance purchase requirements, and blackout dates. Managed in IDeaS G3 RMS and distributed via Sabre SynXis CRS. Drives yield optimization by controlling which rates are bookable under specific conditions.

attributes.name: rate_restriction_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each rate restriction record in the revenue management system. Primary key for the rate_restriction data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: cancellation_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservation.cancellation_policy. Business justification: Revenue managers apply cancellation policy restrictions as part of yield management strategy. Rate restrictions must enforce specific cancellation terms (non-refundable, free cancellation windows) to

attributes.name: market_segment_id
