attributes.description: Property-level EBITDA contribution on the performance date, representing operating earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization. Used for ownership reporting, asset valuation, and management contract performance measurement.

tag_set.value: Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA) Contribution

attributes.name: fb_revenue
attributes.description: Total Food and Beverage revenue generated on the performance date across all F&B outlets (restaurants, bars, banquets, in-room dining). Sourced from Oracle Hospitality MICROS POS and reconciled against SAP S/4HANA. Included in TRevPAR calculation per USALI.

attributes.name: gop
attributes.description: Gross Operating Profit on the performance date, calculated as total operated department revenue minus total operated department expenses per USALI. Key profitability metric for ownership reporting and management contracts.

attributes.name: goppar
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Operating Profit Per Available Room (GOPPAR)
attributes.description: Gross Operating Profit Per Available Room in the property's operating currency, calculated as GOP divided by rooms available. Measures overall property profitability efficiency. Core KPI for ownership reporting and management fee calculations.

tag_set.value: Gross Operating Profit Per Available Room (GOPPAR)

attributes.name: is_reconciled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this daily performance actual record has been reconciled between Oracle OPERA PMS and SAP S/4HANA General Ledger. True = reconciled and approved for reporting; False = pending reconciliation. Supports financial close and SOX controls.

attributes.name: miscellaneous_income
attributes.description: Total miscellaneous and rental income on the performance date including rentals, commissions, and other non-departmental income per USALI non-operating income classification.

attributes.name: mpi
attributes.description: Market Penetration Index representing the property's occupancy performance relative to its competitive set, sourced from STR STAR Report. MPI > 1.0 indicates the property is capturing more than its fair share of market occupancy.

attributes.name: occupancy_rate
attributes.description: Daily occupancy rate expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.8250 = 82.50%), calculated as rooms sold divided by rooms available. Core KPI for the STR STAR Report, DOR, and ownership reporting. Stored as a raw ratio; display layer applies percentage formatting.

attributes.name: parking_revenue
attributes.description: Total parking revenue generated on the performance date from valet, self-park, and garage operations. Classified under other operated departments per USALI and included in TRevPAR.

attributes.name: performance_date
attributes.description: The calendar date (business date) for which this revenue performance actual record applies. Represents the stay date or operating day used in the Daily Operations Report (DOR) and all KPI calculations.

attributes.name: prior_year_revpar
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prior Year Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR)
attributes.description: RevPAR for the same calendar date in the prior year. Used for year-over-year (YOY) variance analysis in the DOR, STR STAR Report benchmarking, and ownership reporting.

tag_set.value: Prior Year Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR)

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of this performance actual record indicating whether figures are preliminary (intra-day), final (end-of-day close), adjusted (post-close correction), or closed (period-locked). Supports audit and reconciliation workflows.

attributes.name: revpar
attributes.description: Revenue Per Available Room in the property's operating currency, calculated as ADR multiplied by occupancy rate (or total room revenue divided by rooms available). Primary rooms revenue KPI for ownership reporting, STR STAR Report, and RGI benchmarking.

attributes.name: rgi
attributes.description: Revenue Generation Index representing the property's RevPAR performance relative to its competitive set, sourced from STR STAR Report. RGI > 1.0 indicates the property is outperforming its comp set. Core competitive benchmarking KPI.

attributes.name: rooms_available
attributes.description: Total number of rooms available for sale on the performance date after deducting out-of-order (OOO) and out-of-service (OOS) rooms. Denominator for Occupancy Rate (OCC) and RevPAR calculations per USALI and STR STAR Report standards.

attributes.name: rooms_complimentary
attributes.description: Number of rooms occupied on a complimentary (no-charge) basis on the performance date. Tracked separately per USALI for accurate ADR and revenue reporting, as complimentary rooms are excluded from ADR calculation.

attributes.name: rooms_out_of_order
attributes.description: Number of rooms designated as out-of-order (OOO) on the performance date due to maintenance, renovation, or damage. Excluded from rooms available per USALI inventory standards.

attributes.name: rooms_sold
attributes.description: Total number of rooms occupied (sold) on the performance date, including complimentary rooms. Used to calculate Occupancy Rate (OCC) and Average Daily Rate (ADR) per USALI standards.

attributes.name: segment_contract_rooms
attributes.description: Number of rooms sold under negotiated contract rates (airline crew, long-stay corporate contracts) on the performance date. Supports contract segment revenue analysis and channel mix reporting.

attributes.name: segment_group_rooms
attributes.description: Number of rooms sold to group accounts (MICE, corporate groups, tour groups) on the performance date. Supports group vs. transient mix analysis and group revenue contribution reporting per USALI.

attributes.name: segment_transient_rooms
attributes.description: Number of rooms sold to transient (individual/FIT) guests on the performance date. Supports segment-level revenue analysis and channel mix reporting per USALI market segmentation standards.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this performance actual record was sourced or reconciled (e.g., Oracle OPERA PMS for rooms data, SAP S/4HANA for financial totals). Supports data lineage and reconciliation audits.

attributes.name: spa_revenue
attributes.description: Total spa and wellness revenue generated on the performance date. Included in total property revenue and TRevPAR calculation per USALI other operated departments classification.

attributes.name: total_property_revenue
attributes.description: Total gross revenue across all operated departments and income streams on the performance date (rooms + F&B + spa + parking + other operated departments + miscellaneous + ancillary). Denominator basis for TRevPAR. Reconciled against SAP S/4HANA GL per USALI.

attributes.name: total_room_revenue
attributes.description: Total gross room revenue generated on the performance date across all rate plans and channels, before deductions. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS and reconciled against SAP S/4HANA GL. Numerator for ADR and RevPAR calculations per USALI.

attributes.name: trevpar
attributes.description: Total Revenue Per Available Room in the property's operating currency, calculated as total property revenue divided by rooms available. Measures total revenue productivity of the property beyond rooms. Core KPI for ownership and management reporting.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this performance actual record was last modified, including post-close adjustments or reconciliation corrections. Supports audit trail and change tracking.

products.name: market_segment
products.description: Master classification of revenue market segments used for demand analysis, pricing strategy, and performance reporting. Defines segment code, segment name, segment category (transient, group, contract, wholesale, OTA, corporate, government, leisure, crew, airline), contribution margin profile, booking behavior characteristics, average lead time, and cancellation propensity. SSOT for market segment taxonomy aligned to STR segment definitions and used across revenue, reservation, and channel domains.

attributes.name: market_segment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the market segment record. Primary key for the market_segment data product in the revenue domain. Role classification: MASTER_RESOURCE — this entity represents a classification resource used across revenue, reservation, and channel domains.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.currency. Business justification: Market segment commission rates and contribution margin tiers are currency-context-dependent. currency_code is denormalized; FK to currency enforces 3NF and supports multi-currency segment profitabili

attributes.name: ada_accommodation_typical
attributes.business_glossary_term: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodation Typical
attributes.description: Indicates whether guests in this market segment typically require ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) accessible accommodations. Relevant for government, medical, and certain group segments. Informs room inventory allocation and accessibility compliance reporting.

tag_set.value: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodation Typical

attributes.name: avg_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Average number of days between booking date and arrival date for this market segment. Key input for demand forecasting in IDeaS G3 RMS and Infor EzRMS. Segments with short lead times (e.g., OTA last-minute) require different yield strategies than long-lead corporate or group segments. Represents the MEASUREMENT_OR_VALUE for this resource.

attributes.name: avg_length_of_stay_nights
attributes.description: Average number of nights guests in this segment stay per booking (ALOS — Average Length of Stay). Used in revenue management for LOS (Length of Stay) restriction optimization, demand forecasting, and RevPAR (Revenue Per Available Room) modeling in IDeaS G3 RMS.

attributes.name: cancellation_propensity
attributes.description: Qualitative classification of the historical cancellation rate tendency for this market segment. Informs overbooking strategy, no-show reserve calculations, and revenue protection policies in IDeaS G3 RMS. High-propensity segments (e.g., OTA flexible rate) require higher overbooking buffers.

attributes.name: channel_affinity
attributes.description: Primary distribution channel through which this market segment predominantly books. Drives channel strategy, OTA (Online Travel Agency) commission management, and GDS (Global Distribution System) rate loading decisions in Sabre SynXis CRS. Used for channel mix analysis and cost-of-acquisition reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: direct|ota|gds|voice|group|wholesale|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: commission_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether bookings in this segment are subject to travel agent or OTA commission payments. Direct corporate and government segments are typically non-commissionable; OTA and GDS segments carry commission obligations. Drives accounts payable commission processing in SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: commission_rate_pct
attributes.description: Standard commission rate percentage applicable to bookings in this segment when commission_eligible is true. Expressed as a percentage of room revenue (e.g., 10.00 for 10%). Used for cost-of-acquisition analysis, OTA contract management, and CPOR (Cost Per Occupied Room) calculations. Confidential as it reflects contracted commercial terms.

attributes.name: contribution_margin_tier
attributes.description: Classification of the segment's typical contribution margin profile relative to other segments. Reflects net revenue after channel commissions, OTA fees, GDS fees, and loyalty redemption costs. Premium tiers (e.g., direct corporate) yield higher GOP (Gross Operating Profit) than low-margin OTA or wholesale segments. Used in GOPPAR analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this market segment record was first created in the enterprise data lakehouse. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and record provenance tracking. Aligns with RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED requirement for MASTER_RESOURCE entities.

attributes.name: crs_segment_code
attributes.description: The segment code as configured in Sabre SynXis CRS for central reservations and channel distribution. Used for rate plan distribution, availability controls, and channel-level segment reporting. Enables cross-system segment reconciliation.

attributes.name: demand_pattern
attributes.description: Classification of the temporal demand pattern exhibited by this market segment. Corporate transient segments typically show weekday concentration; leisure segments show weekend and seasonal peaks; event-driven segments spike around MICE (Meetings Incentives Conferences Exhibitions) events. Used in Infor EzRMS demand forecasting.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the market segment, including its defining characteristics, typical guest profile, booking behavior, and applicable rate strategies. Used for training, documentation, and business glossary alignment across revenue management, reservations, and sales teams.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which this market segment definition becomes active and available for use in reservations, rate plans, and revenue reporting. Supports temporal validity management for segment taxonomy changes aligned with fiscal year or STR reporting period updates.

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date after which this market segment definition is no longer active. Null indicates an open-ended segment with no planned expiry. Supports segment lifecycle management and historical reporting continuity when segment taxonomies are revised.

attributes.name: gdpr_data_subject_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Data Subject Applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether guest data associated with bookings in this market segment is subject to GDPR data subject rights (right to erasure, portability, access). Relevant for segments involving EU/EEA guests. Drives data retention and anonymization policies in the data lakehouse.

tag_set.value: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Data Subject Applicable

attributes.name: gds_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether rates for this market segment are distributed through GDS (Global Distribution System) channels such as Amadeus, Sabre, and Travelport. Controls rate loading and availability display in Sabre SynXis CRS for GDS-connected travel agencies.

attributes.name: group_block_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this market segment supports group room block reservations. Group-eligible segments (e.g., MICE, sports groups, tour groups) require group block management in Oracle OPERA PMS and Delphi by Amadeus for BEO (Banquet Event Order) coordination.

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level of this segment within the market segment hierarchy. Level 1 represents top-level categories (e.g., Transient, Group); Level 2 represents sub-categories (e.g., Corporate, Leisure); Level 3 represents granular segments (e.g., Corporate Negotiated, Leisure OTA). Used for hierarchical roll-up in revenue reporting.

attributes.name: is_internal_use_only
attributes.description: Indicates whether this market segment is for internal reporting and analytics purposes only and should not be exposed to guests, OTA partners, or external distribution channels. Internal segments (e.g., complimentary, house use, employee rate) are excluded from external rate distribution in Sabre SynXis CRS.

attributes.name: loyalty_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether bookings under this market segment are eligible to earn loyalty program points and benefits. Wholesale, crew, and certain contracted segments may be excluded from loyalty accrual per program rules. Drives loyalty point calculation logic in Salesforce CRM loyalty management.

attributes.name: market_segment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the market segment record. Active segments are available for rate plan assignment, reservation coding, and revenue reporting. Inactive or deprecated segments are retained for historical analysis but excluded from new bookings. Aligns with MASTER_RESOURCE LIFECYCLE_STATUS requirement.

attributes.name: min_rate_override_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether revenue managers are permitted to override the minimum rate floor for this segment. Restricting overrides for high-value segments (e.g., LRA corporate) protects rate integrity. Configurable in IDeaS G3 RMS inventory controls and Oracle OPERA PMS rate management.

attributes.name: negotiated_rate_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether bookings in this segment require a pre-negotiated rate agreement (e.g., corporate account rate, government per diem, airline crew contract). When true, a valid rate agreement must exist before reservations can be accepted at segment rates in Oracle OPERA PMS.

attributes.name: no_show_propensity
attributes.description: Qualitative classification of the historical no-show rate tendency for this market segment. Distinct from cancellation propensity — no-shows occur without prior cancellation and have different revenue recovery implications. Used in overbooking model calibration within IDeaS G3 RMS.

attributes.name: ota_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether rates for this market segment are distributed through OTA (Online Travel Agency) channels such as Expedia, Booking.com, and Hotels.com. Controls channel availability in Sabre SynXis CRS and impacts OTA commission cost tracking.

attributes.name: pci_scope
attributes.description: Indicates whether payment card data associated with bookings in this segment falls within PCI DSS scope. Segments with direct card-present or card-not-present transactions require PCI-compliant data handling. Drives data masking and tokenization requirements in the lakehouse.

attributes.name: pms_segment_code
attributes.description: The segment code as configured in Oracle OPERA PMS. Used for reservation coding, folio routing, and rate plan assignment at the property level. Enables reconciliation between the enterprise data lakehouse and the operational PMS source system.

attributes.name: price_sensitivity
attributes.description: Classification of the segment's sensitivity to rate changes. Inelastic segments (e.g., airline crew, government contracted) book regardless of rate fluctuations. Highly elastic segments (e.g., leisure OTA) respond strongly to price changes. Drives DRR (Dynamic Rate Rule) configuration in IDeaS G3 RMS.

attributes.name: rate_plan_category
attributes.description: Classification of the rate plan type typically associated with this segment. BAR (Best Available Rate) for transient leisure, negotiated for corporate accounts, LRA (Last Room Availability) for top-tier corporate, NRR (Non-Refundable Rate) for advance purchase segments. Drives rate loading in Oracle OPERA PMS and Sabre SynXis CRS. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bar|negotiated|lra|nrr|wholesale|package|complimentary — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: revenue_bucket
attributes.description: Primary revenue category associated with this market segment for TRevPAR (Total Revenue Per Available Room) and USALI departmental reporting. Rooms-focused segments contribute primarily to rooms revenue; MICE segments contribute across rooms, F&B (Food and Beverage), and events revenue buckets.

attributes.name: rms_segment_code
attributes.description: The segment code as configured in IDeaS G3 RMS or Infor EzRMS. Used for demand forecasting, pricing optimization, and inventory control at the segment level. May differ from PMS segment code due to system-specific taxonomy requirements.

attributes.name: segment_category
attributes.description: High-level classification grouping the segment into a primary demand category. Drives pricing strategy, channel allocation, and revenue reporting roll-ups. Aligns with STR segment category definitions used in STAR Report benchmarking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: transient|group|contract|wholesale|ota|corporate|government|leisure|crew|airline — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the market segment, used as the externally-known business identifier across Oracle OPERA PMS, IDeaS G3 RMS, Sabre SynXis CRS, and Infor EzRMS. Examples: CORP, TRANS, LEIS, OTA, GRP, GOVT, CREW. Aligns with STR segment code taxonomy for benchmarking and STAR Report mapping.

attributes.name: segment_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the market segment as displayed in reporting, dashboards, and revenue management systems. Examples: Corporate Negotiated, Leisure Transient, Online Travel Agency, Government/Military, Group Meetings. Used as the IDENTITY_LABEL for this resource entity.

attributes.name: segment_type
attributes.description: Secondary classification distinguishing whether the segment represents individual (FIT — Free Independent Traveler) bookings, group blocks, negotiated corporate accounts, wholesale/tour operator contracts, or consortia arrangements. Used in IDeaS G3 RMS for demand segmentation and pricing strategy.

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Numeric value controlling the display sequence of market segments in reports, dashboards, and system configuration screens. Ensures consistent ordering in Oracle OPERA PMS segment lists, IDeaS G3 RMS segment configuration, and BI reporting tools.

attributes.name: str_segment_code
attributes.description: The official STR (Smith Travel Research) segment code used for competitive benchmarking and STAR Report alignment. Enables mapping of internal segment definitions to the industry-standard STR taxonomy for RGI (Revenue Generation Index), MPI (Market Penetration Index), and ARI (Average Rate Index) calculations.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this market segment record was last modified. Tracks configuration changes to segment definitions, status updates, and taxonomy revisions. Essential for change data capture (CDC) in ETL pipelines feeding IDeaS G3 RMS and Infor EzRMS.

attributes.name: usali_segment_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry (USALI) Segment Code
attributes.description: The USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry) standardized segment code used for financial reporting and departmental P&L allocation. Ensures consistency in GOP (Gross Operating Profit), NOI (Net Operating Income), and EBITDA reporting across properties and for external financial audits under GAAP/IFRS.

tag_set.value: Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry (USALI) Segment Code

products.name: budget
products.description: Revenue planning, strategy, and budget records combining strategic revenue targets with financial budget commitments at the property and market segment level, aligned to USALI standards. Captures planning period, property, strategy type (transient, group, total revenue), target and budgeted ADR/occupancy/RevPAR/TRevPAR, budgeted room revenue, key tactical actions and strategic initiatives, budget version (original, revised, reforecast), strategy status (draft, approved, active), planning horizon, and approving revenue director. This is the SSOT for all revenue planning governance — both strategic direction and financial targets — used for variance analysis against actuals in the DOR, management reporting, owner presentations, and strategic revenue governance.

attributes.name: budget_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each revenue budget record. Primary key for the revenue_budget data product in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: budgeted_fnb_outlet_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fnb.fnb_outlet. Business justification: Revenue budgets include outlet-level F&B targets for total property budget planning. Required for USALI budget preparation, outlet performance targets, variance analysis, GOP planning at department le

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.currency. Business justification: All revenue_budget monetary targets (budgeted_room_revenue, budgeted_gop, target_adr) are currency-denominated. currency_code is denormalized; FK to currency enforces 3NF and enables multi-currency bu

attributes.name: demand_forecast_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.demand_forecast. Business justification: Revenue budgets and strategic plans in hospitality are built on top of demand forecasts — the target_occupancy_rate, target_adr, and target_revpar in revenue_budget are derived from demand forecast pr

attributes.name: hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.hierarchy. Business justification: Revenue budgets are planned and approved at hierarchy node levels (brand, region, cluster). Linking revenue_budget to hierarchy enables hierarchical budget rollup for regional VP review, brand portfol

attributes.name: market_segment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the market segment (e.g., transient leisure, transient corporate, group, wholesale, OTA) for which this budget is defined. Enables segment-level revenue planning and variance analysis.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property for which this revenue budget applies. Links to the property master record in the Property domain.

attributes.name: revenue_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fnb.revenue_center. Business justification: USALI standard hotel budgeting sets F&B targets at the revenue center level (e.g., restaurant vs. bar vs. banquet). revenue_budget has budgeted_fb_revenue but no revenue_center FK. This link supports

attributes.name: seasonal_calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.seasonal_calendar. Business justification: Revenue budgets are planned by season (peak, shoulder, off-peak). Linking revenue_budget to seasonal_calendar enables season-based budget variance reporting, supports annual planning cycles aligned to

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the revenue director formally approved this budget version. Marks the transition from 'draft' to 'approved' strategy status.

attributes.name: budgeted_available_rooms
attributes.description: Total number of room-nights planned to be available for sale during the planning period (capacity baseline). Used as the denominator for RevPAR, TRevPAR, and GOPPAR calculations and STR STAR Report benchmarking.

attributes.name: budgeted_cpor
attributes.description: Budgeted Cost Per Occupied Room (CPOR) in the property's operating currency, representing the planned direct operating cost per occupied room night. Used for profitability planning and variance analysis against actuals.

attributes.name: budgeted_events_revenue
attributes.description: Total budgeted revenue from Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, and Exhibitions (MICE) and event spaces for the planning period. Supports TRevPAR planning and event sales governance in Delphi by Amadeus.

attributes.name: budgeted_fb_revenue
attributes.description: Total budgeted Food and Beverage (F&B) revenue in the property's operating currency for the planning period. Supports TRevPAR planning and USALI departmental revenue reporting.

attributes.name: budgeted_gop
attributes.description: Budgeted Gross Operating Profit (GOP) in the property's operating currency for the planning period, per USALI departmental and undistributed expense structure. Used for GOPPAR derivation and owner NOI reporting.

attributes.name: budgeted_occupied_rooms
attributes.description: Total number of room-nights planned to be occupied (sold) during the planning period. Derived from budgeted available rooms × target OCC, stored as a planning target for demand forecasting and group block management.

attributes.name: budgeted_other_revenue
attributes.description: Total budgeted ancillary revenue (spa, parking, resort fees, retail, etc.) in the property's operating currency for the planning period. Completes the TRevPAR revenue stack beyond rooms, F&B, and events.

attributes.name: budgeted_room_revenue
attributes.description: Total budgeted room revenue (in operating currency) for the planning period and market segment. The primary monetary commitment in the revenue budget, used for variance analysis against actuals in the DOR and management reporting. Classified confidential as a strategic financial target.

attributes.name: budgeted_total_revenue
attributes.description: Aggregate budgeted total revenue across all revenue streams (rooms + F&B + events + other) in the property's operating currency for the planning period. The top-line financial commitment used in owner presentations and EBITDA planning.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this revenue budget record was first created in the lakehouse Silver Layer. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX financial controls compliance.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal month or period number (1–12) within the fiscal year for monthly budget granularity. Supports period-level variance analysis in the DOR and management reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this revenue budget belongs (e.g., 2025). Aligns with the property's USALI-compliant financial reporting calendar and SAP S/4HANA GL fiscal periods.

attributes.name: is_owner_approved
attributes.description: Indicates whether this budget has received formal approval from the property owner or ownership group (True = owner-approved; False = pending or not required). Relevant for managed properties where owner sign-off is contractually required.

attributes.name: key_tactical_actions
attributes.description: Free-text description of the near-term tactical revenue actions planned for this budget period (e.g., BAR adjustments, LRA controls, OTA channel mix shifts, promotional rate activations). Captured from the revenue strategy narrative in IDeaS G3 RMS and Infor EzRMS.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, assumptions, or commentary associated with this revenue budget record (e.g., macro-economic assumptions, renovation impact adjustments, force majeure notes). Supports management reporting and audit documentation.

attributes.name: planning_horizon_type
attributes.description: Granularity of the planning horizon for this budget record: 'annual' (full-year plan), 'quarterly' (90-day rolling), 'monthly' (period-level), or 'weekly' (short-term tactical). Determines the reporting cadence for variance analysis.

attributes.name: planning_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the planning horizon covered by this revenue budget (e.g., 2025-12-31 for an annual plan). Defines the effective end of the budget period.

attributes.name: planning_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the planning horizon covered by this revenue budget (e.g., 2025-01-01 for an annual plan). Defines the effective start of the budget period for variance tracking against actuals.

attributes.name: property_segment
attributes.description: Brand/service tier of the property for which this budget applies: 'luxury', 'premium', 'select_service', or 'extended_stay'. Enables cross-segment benchmarking and portfolio-level revenue governance.

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for this budget record, used in management reports, owner presentations, and cross-system references (e.g., SAP S/4HANA GL budget entries). Format: RB-{PropertyCode}-{Year}.

attributes.name: strategic_initiatives
attributes.description: Free-text description of longer-horizon strategic revenue initiatives included in this budget (e.g., loyalty program rate strategy, new OTA partnership, dynamic pricing rule (DRR) rollout, group business development targets). Supports owner presentations and management reporting.

attributes.name: strategy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this revenue budget and strategy record. 'draft' = under preparation; 'approved' = signed off by revenue director; 'active' = in-period execution; 'superseded' = replaced by a newer version; 'archived' = closed period record.

attributes.name: strategy_type
attributes.description: Classifies the revenue strategy scope covered by this budget: 'transient' (FIT/BAR-driven room revenue), 'group' (MICE and group block revenue), 'total_revenue' (TRevPAR-level all-revenue planning), 'food_and_beverage' (F&B revenue plan), 'events' (event/conference revenue), or 'other'. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: transient|group|total_revenue|food_and_beverage|events|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which this budget version was formally submitted for review and approval. Used for governance tracking and audit trail in owner presentations and management reporting.

attributes.name: target_adr
attributes.description: Budgeted Average Daily Rate (ADR) in the property's operating currency for the planning period. Represents the planned average revenue earned per occupied room per night. Core revenue KPI used in STR STAR Report, RGI, and MPI benchmarking.

attributes.name: target_alos
attributes.description: Budgeted Average Length of Stay (ALOS) in nights for the planning period and market segment. Supports LOS-based pricing strategy, minimum stay restrictions, and demand pattern planning in IDeaS G3 RMS.

attributes.name: target_ari
attributes.description: Budgeted Average Rate Index (ARI) target, representing the property's planned ADR performance relative to its STR competitive set (property ADR / comp set ADR). Supports rate strategy and competitive positioning planning.

attributes.name: target_goppar
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target Gross Operating Profit Per Available Room (GOPPAR)
attributes.description: Budgeted Gross Operating Profit Per Available Room (GOPPAR) in the property's operating currency. Represents the profitability target per available room after operating expenses, used in owner presentations and GOP governance.

tag_set.value: Target Gross Operating Profit Per Available Room (GOPPAR)

attributes.name: target_mpi
attributes.description: Budgeted Market Penetration Index (MPI) target, representing the property's planned occupancy performance relative to its STR competitive set (property OCC / comp set OCC). Supports competitive benchmarking strategy.

attributes.name: target_occupancy_rate
attributes.description: Budgeted occupancy rate (OCC) expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00) for the planning period. Represents the planned proportion of available rooms expected to be sold. Core KPI input for RevPAR calculation and STR STAR Report benchmarking.

attributes.name: target_revpar
attributes.description: Budgeted Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR) in the property's operating currency for the planning period. Calculated as ADR × OCC but stored as a strategic target for direct comparison against actuals and STR competitive set benchmarks (RGI).

attributes.name: target_rgi
attributes.description: Budgeted Revenue Generation Index (RGI) target, representing the property's planned RevPAR performance relative to its STR competitive set (property RevPAR / comp set RevPAR). RGI > 1.0 indicates planned market share gain.

attributes.name: target_trevpar
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target Total Revenue Per Available Room (TRevPAR)

attributes.name: is_non_refundable

attributes.name: max_los

attributes.name: min_los

attributes.name: min_night_commitment

attributes.name: negotiation_owner

attributes.name: rate_bar_variance_pct

attributes.name: rate_code

attributes.name: rate_includes_tax

attributes.name: rate_name

attributes.name: rate_status

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

products.name: restriction_application
products.description: This association product represents the operational application of a rate restriction to a specific rate availability record in the revenue management system. It captures the active state of each restriction-to-availability pairing as managed in IDeaS G3 RMS and distributed via Sabre SynXis CRS. Each record links one rate_availability snapshot to one rate_restriction rule with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific application — including activation timestamp, distribution status, priority rank for conflict resolution, and override authorization state.. Existence Justification: In IDeaS G3 RMS and Sabre SynXis CRS, revenue managers explicitly apply multiple rate restrictions (min LOS, CTA, CTD, advance purchase, blackout) simultaneously to a single rate availability record, and a single restriction definition (e.g., a 2-night minimum LOS rule) covers many availability records across its date range, room type scope, and rate plan scope. This is an actively managed operational concept — revenue managers create, activate, override, and expire these restriction-to-availability pairings as a core yield optimization workflow. The relationship is a first-class operational entity called 'restriction_application' in RMS terminology, carrying its own status, priority, and override metadata.

attributes.name: restriction_application_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the restriction_application association

attributes.name: rate_availability_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the specific daily rate and availability snapshot to which this restriction is applied.

attributes.name: rate_restriction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the rate restriction rule being applied to the availability record.

attributes.name: advance_purchase_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days in advance a booking must be made to qualify for this rate plan on the snapshot date (e.g., 7-day advance purchase, 21-day advance purchase for NRR rates). A key rate restriction parameter managed in IDeaS G3 RMS and Sabre SynXis CRS. [Moved from rate_availability: Advance purchase requirement is a restriction rule attribute defined on rate_restriction. Its presence on rate_availability is a denormalized snapshot of the active restriction. The restriction_application association provides the proper operational link between the restriction definition and the availability record.]

attributes.name: applied_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this specific restriction was activated and applied to the linked rate availability record. Sourced from detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: closed_to_arrival
attributes.description: Indicates whether new arrivals are blocked on the snapshot date for this room type and rate plan. When True, guests cannot check in on this date but may continue an existing stay through it. A yield management restriction used to optimize multi-night booking patterns. [Moved from rate_availability: CTA is a restriction type managed in rate_restriction. Its presence on rate_availability is a denormalized snapshot. The restriction_application association captures which specific CTA restriction record is applied to which availability record, with its own status and override state.]

attributes.name: closed_to_departure
attributes.description: Indicates whether departures are blocked on the snapshot date for this room type and rate plan. When True, guests cannot check out on this date, forcing stays to extend through it. Used in conjunction with CTA restrictions to shape booking patterns during peak periods. [Moved from rate_availability: CTD is a restriction type managed in rate_restriction. Same reasoning as closed_to_arrival — the denormalized boolean on rate_availability should be derived from the active restriction_application records rather than stored redundantly.]

attributes.name: distribution_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specific restriction application has been successfully distributed to connected channel systems (GDS, OTA, CRS) for this availability record. Distinct from the restriction-level distribution_status on rate_restriction. Sourced from detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: los_maximum
attributes.description: Maximum number of nights permitted under this rate plan for the snapshot date. Used to prevent long-stay bookings at promotional rates during high-demand periods. Managed in IDeaS G3 RMS as an upper LOS (Length of Stay) restriction. [Moved from rate_availability: Same reasoning as los_minimum — maximum LOS is a restriction rule attribute. Its denormalization on rate_availability collapses multiple simultaneous restriction applications into a single value, losing the operational detail that restriction_application captures.]

attributes.name: los_minimum
attributes.description: Minimum number of nights a guest must stay to qualify for this rate plan on the snapshot date. A key yield optimization restriction managed in IDeaS G3 RMS. LOS (Length of Stay) restrictions are used to maximize revenue during high-demand periods by requiring multi-night commitments. [Moved from rate_availability: Minimum LOS is a restriction attribute that belongs to the restriction_application pairing. Its presence on rate_availability represents a denormalized snapshot of the currently active restriction. When multiple restrictions with different LOS rules apply simultaneously, a single los_minimum on rate_availability cannot represent the full picture. The authoritative value lives on rate_restriction and the effective application state lives on restriction_application.]

attributes.name: override_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a revenue manager or authorized staff member is permitted to manually override this specific restriction application for the linked availability record. Sourced from detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric priority rank used to resolve conflicts when multiple restrictions are simultaneously applied to the same rate availability record. Determines which restriction takes precedence when rules conflict. Sourced from detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: restriction_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of this specific restriction-to-availability pairing. Tracks whether the restriction is actively enforced, has expired, or has been overridden for this availability record. Sourced from detection phase relationship data.

domains.name: loyalty
domains.description: Guest loyalty program management including membership enrollment, tier management, points accrual and redemption, elite status benefits, partner integrations, and rewards fulfillment. Tracks member activity, lifetime value (LTV), engagement metrics, SALT (Satisfaction and Loyalty Tracking), and program economics. Supports personalized offers, tier upgrades, and retention campaigns.

products.name: member
products.description: Core master entity representing a guest enrolled in the loyalty program. Captures membership identity, enrollment date, current tier assignment (FK to tier), lifetime points balance, LTV metrics (total revenue, stays, nights), SALT scores, program opt-in preferences, communication consent, membership number, and account status (active, suspended, closed). This is the SSOT for loyalty membership identity and current member state — distinct from the guest profile in the guest domain, which owns PII and stay history. References guest_id as a foreign key to the guest domain. Also serves as the anchor for member segment assignments (segment memberships tracked temporally within member_segment).
products.reference: Loyalty Member / CRM Member Record (Salesforce CRM)

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the loyalty program member. Primary key.

attributes.name: enrollment_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel. Business justification: Loyalty enrollment attribution reporting requires linking each member to the channel through which they enrolled. The plain-text enrollment_channel attribute is a denormalization of channel.channel. M

attributes.name: primary_member_enrollment_hotel_property_id

attributes.name: primary_member_guest_profile_id

attributes.name: email_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has consented to receive email communications. Separate from general communication opt-in for channel-specific consent.

attributes.name: enrollment_date

attributes.name: language_preference
attributes.description: Member's preferred language for communications and service delivery. Three-letter ISO 639-2 language code.

attributes.name: last_stay_date
attributes.description: Date of the member's most recent completed stay. Used for recency analysis and churn prediction.

attributes.name: lifetime_nights
attributes.description: Total number of room nights stayed by the member since enrollment. Used for tier qualification and LTV (Lifetime Value) calculation.

attributes.name: lifetime_points_earned
attributes.description: Total cumulative points earned by the member since enrollment. Used for tier qualification and lifetime value tracking.

attributes.name: lifetime_revenue
attributes.description: Total revenue generated by the member across all stays, F&B (Food and Beverage), and ancillary services since enrollment. Key LTV (Lifetime Value) metric.

attributes.name: lifetime_stays
attributes.description: Total number of completed stays by the member since enrollment. Key metric for member engagement and tier qualification.

attributes.name: membership_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique membership identifier assigned to the loyalty program member. Used for member recognition and program transactions.

attributes.name: membership_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the loyalty membership account. Active members can accrue and redeem points; suspended or closed accounts have restricted access.

attributes.name: next_stay_date
attributes.description: Date of the member's next confirmed reservation. Used for engagement tracking and personalized offers.

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Most recent NPS (Net Promoter Score) rating provided by the member. Scale of -100 to 100, measuring likelihood to recommend the brand.

attributes.name: partner_sharing_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has consented to share their data with loyalty program partners (airlines, car rentals, etc.) for cross-program benefits.

attributes.name: points_expired
attributes.description: Total cumulative points that have expired due to inactivity or program rules.

attributes.name: points_redeemed
attributes.description: Total cumulative points redeemed by the member for rewards, upgrades, or benefits since enrollment.

attributes.name: salt_score
attributes.description: SALT (Satisfaction and Loyalty Tracking) composite score measuring member satisfaction and loyalty. Proprietary metric combining multiple engagement and satisfaction indicators.

attributes.name: sms_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has consented to receive SMS/text message communications.

attributes.name: tier_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the member's current tier status expires. Used for tier renewal campaigns and retention efforts.

attributes.name: tier_qualification_date
attributes.description: Date when the member qualified for their current tier. Used for tier anniversary tracking and benefit eligibility.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the member record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: vip_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member is designated as a VIP for special recognition and service. May be based on tier, LTV (Lifetime Value), or manual assignment.

attributes.name: ytd_nights
attributes.description: Number of room nights stayed by the member in the current calendar year. Used for annual tier qualification.

attributes.name: ytd_revenue
attributes.description: Total revenue generated by the member in the current calendar year. Used for tier qualification and annual performance tracking.

attributes.name: ytd_stays
attributes.description: Number of completed stays by the member in the current calendar year. Used for annual tier qualification.

products.name: tier
products.description: Reference master defining the loyalty program tier hierarchy (e.g., Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond). Captures tier name, tier code, qualification thresholds (nights, stays, points, spend), benefit entitlements, upgrade/downgrade rules, tier validity period, and display order. Governs tier assignment logic and benefit eligibility across the program.

attributes.name: bonus_points_on_enrollment

attributes.name: breakfast_benefit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members at this tier receive complimentary breakfast during their stays.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the tier (e.g., SILVER, GOLD, PLATINUM, DIAMOND). Used for system integration and display.

attributes.description: Detailed description of the tier, including benefits summary and value proposition, used for member communications and marketing.

attributes.name: display_order
attributes.description: Numeric sort order for displaying tiers in user interfaces and reports. Lower numbers appear first.

attributes.name: early_checkin_hours

attributes.description: Date when this tier definition became or will become active and available for member assignment.

attributes.description: Indicates whether members at this tier have guaranteed room availability when booking within specified advance notice periods.

attributes.name: icon_url
attributes.description: URL or path to the icon or badge image representing this tier in digital channels.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tier record was last updated.

attributes.name: late_checkout_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours past standard checkout time that members at this tier are entitled to for late checkout (e.g., 2 for 2pm checkout when standard is 12pm).

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: Numeric ranking of the tier within the program hierarchy. Lower numbers indicate entry-level tiers, higher numbers indicate elite status. Used for tier comparison and upgrade logic.

attributes.name: lounge_access_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members at this tier have complimentary access to executive lounges or club floors at participating properties.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full display name of the loyalty tier (e.g., Silver Elite, Gold Premier, Platinum Honors, Diamond Ambassador).

attributes.name: points_earning_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to base points earning for members at this tier (e.g., 1.5 means 50% bonus points, 2.0 means double points).

attributes.name: priority_reservation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members at this tier receive priority handling for reservations and waitlist requests.

attributes.name: qualification_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the qualification spend threshold (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: qualification_nights_threshold

attributes.name: qualification_period_months
attributes.description: Number of months over which qualification activity is measured (e.g., 12 for annual qualification, 24 for rolling two-year window).

attributes.name: qualification_points_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum number of loyalty points required to achieve or maintain this tier status within the qualification period.

attributes.name: qualification_spend_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum monetary spend amount required to achieve or maintain this tier status within the qualification period. Typically measured in the program's base currency.

attributes.name: qualification_stays_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum number of qualifying stays required to achieve or maintain this tier status within the qualification period.

attributes.description: Indicates whether members at this tier are eligible for complimentary room upgrades at check-in (subject to availability).

attributes.name: tier_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the tier. Active tiers are available for member assignment; inactive tiers are temporarily suspended; discontinued tiers are retired but may have legacy members.

attributes.name: validity_months
attributes.description: Number of months that tier status remains valid once achieved, before re-qualification is required (e.g., 12 for annual renewal, 24 for two-year validity).

attributes.name: welcome_amenity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members at this tier receive a welcome amenity (e.g., fruit basket, beverage credit) upon arrival.

products.name: points_ledger
products.description: Authoritative transactional ledger recording every points movement for a loyalty member — including accruals, redemptions, expirations, adjustments, and partner transfers. Each row is an immutable debit or credit entry capturing transaction type (earn, redeem, expire, adjust, transfer_out, transfer_in, bonus), points amount, balance after transaction, source activity (stay, F&B spend, partner purchase, promotion), activity date, posting date, expiry date, originating system reference. For transfer-type entries: partner program reference, transfer direction, conversion rate applied, partner confirmation number, transfer status, and fee charged. This is the SSOT for points balance, movement history, and partner transfer activity.

attributes.name: created_by

products.name: promotion

For member participation: enrollment date, enrollment channel, member promotion status (enrolled, in-progress, completed, expired, awarded), qualifying activity progress, bonus awarded flag, award date, and opt-out date. Drives personalized offer delivery, campaign economics, and promotion fulfillment tracking.
products.reference: Loyalty Promotion / Bonus Offer / Targeted Campaign Offer

attributes.name: marketing_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel. Business justification: Loyalty promotions are distributed through specific channels (OTA, direct, GDS). The plain-text marketing_channel attribute is a denormalization of channel.channel. Channel-level promotion performance

attributes.name: property_id

attributes.name: seasonal_calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.seasonal_calendar. Business justification: Loyalty promotions (double points, bonus nights) are coordinated with seasonal demand periods. Linking promotion to seasonal_calendar enables revenue management teams to align loyalty incentives with

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this promotion was formally approved for launch. Null if promotion is still in draft or pending approval. Used for campaign governance and audit trail.

attributes.name: approved_by

attributes.name: award_fulfillment_date
attributes.description: Target date by which bonus points or nights will be posted to qualifying members' accounts after promotion completion. Used for member communication and fulfillment SLA (Service Level Agreement) tracking.

attributes.name: bonus_nights_credit
attributes.description: Number of bonus elite-qualifying nights awarded upon promotion completion. Used for tier progression acceleration. Null if promotion does not award night credits.

attributes.name: bonus_points_amount

attributes.name: bonus_points_multiplier

attributes.name: budget_cap_amount

attributes.name: budget_consumed_amount

attributes.name: cancellation_reason

attributes.name: code

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: minimum_spend_amount

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the promotion displayed to members and in marketing channels. Example: 'Double Points Summer Getaway', 'Elite Status Fast Track'.

attributes.name: promotion_status

attributes.name: promotion_type
attributes.description: Classification of the promotion mechanism. Values: bonus_points_multiplier (earn extra points per dollar), double_nights (accelerate tier qualification), targeted_offer (personalized to segment), welcome_back (re-engagement), birthday_bonus (member birthday reward), spend_challenge (gamified spending goal).

attributes.name: qualifying_criteria_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative of the requirements a member must meet to earn the promotion bonus. Examples: 'Complete 3 stays between June 1 and August 31', 'Spend minimum $500 on F&B (Food and Beverage) during stay', 'Book via mobile app using rate code MOBILE2024'.

attributes.name: qualifying_property_list

attributes.name: qualifying_rate_codes

attributes.name: terms_and_conditions_url

attributes.name: total_enrollments
attributes.description: Count of unique members who have enrolled or been auto-enrolled in this promotion. Used for campaign reach and engagement metrics.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this promotion record was last modified. Updated whenever any attribute changes. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or employee ID of the marketing or loyalty team member who created this promotion record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

products.name: promotion_enrollment
products.description: This association product represents the Enrollment event between a loyalty promotion and a loyalty member. It captures the full lifecycle of a member's participation in a specific promotion — from registration through qualifying activity progress to bonus award or expiry. Each record links one promotion to one member and carries attributes that exist only in the context of that specific member-promotion participation: enrollment channel, status, qualifying progress, and award outcome. This is the operational source of truth for promotion fulfillment tracking and the source for the aggregate counters (total_enrollments, total_completions) on the promotion entity.. Existence Justification: In loyalty program operations, a member can enroll in multiple promotions simultaneously (e.g., a birthday bonus AND a spend challenge AND a double nights offer), and each promotion is designed to attract and track hundreds or thousands of members. The business actively manages each member-promotion enrollment as a distinct operational record — tracking enrollment date, progress toward qualifying criteria, completion status, and bonus award. This is a textbook operational M:N: the enrollment itself is a named business concept with rich lifecycle data that belongs to neither the promotion nor the member alone.

attributes.name: promotion_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the promotion_enrollment association

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking this enrollment record to the enrolled loyalty member.

attributes.name: promotion_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking this enrollment record to the parent loyalty promotion.

attributes.name: award_date
attributes.description: Date when the bonus points or nights were posted to the member's account for this promotion enrollment. Used for fulfillment tracking and reconciliation.

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the member successfully completed all qualifying criteria for this promotion. Null if not yet completed. Source for promotion.total_completions aggregate.

attributes.name: enrollment_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the member enrolled in the promotion (e.g., web, mobile_app, front_desk, email_link, auto_enrolled). Belongs to the enrollment event, not to the member or promotion.

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date when the member enrolled or was auto-enrolled in the promotion. Belongs to the enrollment relationship, not to the member or promotion alone. Source for promotion.total_enrollments aggregate.

attributes.name: exclusion_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of member IDs or segments explicitly excluded from this promotion (e.g., employees, test accounts, members who opted out). Null if no exclusions apply. [Moved from promotion: The exclusion_list on promotion is an anti-pattern (comma-separated member IDs stored as STRING). Member-level exclusion state belongs in the enrollment association as a status value (e.g., status = 'excluded') or as a separate exclusion flag on the enrollment record. This attribute should be removed from promotion and replaced by querying enrollment records with excluded status.]

attributes.name: opt_out_date
attributes.description: Date when the member opted out of this specific promotion enrollment. Null if still active or completed. Belongs to the enrollment lifecycle.

attributes.name: points_awarded
attributes.description: Actual bonus points awarded to this member upon completion of this promotion. May differ from promotion.bonus_points_amount if pro-rated or adjusted. Belongs to the enrollment outcome, not to the member's lifetime balance or the promotion's budget.

attributes.name: promotion_enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this member's participation in the promotion. Tracks progress from enrollment through completion or expiry.

attributes.name: qualifying_spend_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative qualifying spend the member has accumulated toward this promotion's minimum_spend_amount requirement. Belongs to the enrollment relationship.

attributes.name: qualifying_stays_count
attributes.description: Number of qualifying stays the member has accumulated toward this promotion's minimum_nights requirement. Belongs to the enrollment relationship as it tracks progress specific to this member-promotion pair.

attributes.name: registration_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp of the enrollment event, capturing the exact moment the member registered. Used for audit trail and channel attribution.

domains.name: channel
domains.description: Distribution channel management including OTA partnerships, GDS connectivity, direct booking channels, CRS (Sabre SynXis) channel mapping, and rate parity monitoring. Manages channel performance, commission structures, connectivity fees, booking source attribution, and channel mix optimization. Tracks cost of acquisition and channel contribution to revenue.

products.name: channel
products.description: Master registry of all distribution channels through which Travel Hospitality properties sell inventory, including OTA platforms (Expedia, Booking.com), GDS networks (Sabre, Amadeus, Galileo), direct web/mobile, voice/call center, corporate direct, wholesalers, and metasearch engines. Captures channel type, connectivity method, commission tier, rate parity obligations, and channel-level SLA parameters. This is the SSOT for channel identity across the enterprise.

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Primary key for channel

attributes.name: ota_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.ota_partner. Business justification: Many distribution channels are operated by OTA partners (e.g., Expedia operates multiple channels/brands). This FK establishes the ownership relationship. Removes redundant platform_name which can be

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this distribution channel was first activated and began accepting live bookings. Distinct from contract_start_date which reflects the commercial agreement date. Used for channel onboarding tracking and performance benchmarking from go-live.

attributes.name: bar_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this channel is eligible to display and sell the Best Available Rate (BAR) — the lowest publicly available rate at the time of booking. True = BAR rates are distributed to this channel; False = channel receives only specific contracted or negotiated rates. Drives rate distribution strategy in IDeaS G3 RMS and Sabre SynXis CRS.

attributes.name: booking_fee_usd
attributes.description: Per-transaction booking fee charged by the channel in addition to or instead of a commission percentage, expressed in USD. Common in GDS channels (e.g., GDS segment fee per booking). Used in cost-of-acquisition and channel profitability analysis.

attributes.name: cancellation_policy_code
attributes.description: Code referencing the default cancellation policy applied to bookings made through this channel (e.g., '24H_FREE', '48H_PENALTY', 'NON_REFUNDABLE'). Cancellation policies may differ by channel based on contractual agreements. Managed in Oracle OPERA PMS and Sabre SynXis CRS.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: High-level grouping of the channel by booking relationship: DIRECT = guest books directly with the property (web, mobile, voice, corporate direct); INDIRECT = third-party intermediary involved (OTA, GDS, wholesaler, metasearch); OPAQUE = rate and property identity concealed until after booking (e.g., Hotwire, Priceline opaque). Drives cost-of-acquisition analysis and channel mix strategy.

attributes.name: channel_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the distribution channel. active = channel is live and accepting bookings; inactive = channel is configured but not currently selling; suspended = channel temporarily halted (e.g., rate parity violation, connectivity issue); pending_activation = channel onboarded but not yet live; decommissioned = channel permanently retired.

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the distribution channel by its market segment and technology interface. OTA = Online Travel Agency (e.g., Expedia, Booking.com); GDS = Global Distribution System (e.g., Sabre, Amadeus, Galileo); DIRECT_WEB = brand.com web booking; DIRECT_MOBILE = brand mobile app; VOICE = call center reservations; CORPORATE_DIRECT = negotiated corporate accounts; WHOLESALER = tour operators and bed banks; METASEARCH = Google Hotel Ads, Trivago. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: OTA|GDS|DIRECT_WEB|DIRECT_MOBILE|VOICE|CORPORATE_DIRECT|WHOLESALER|METASEARCH — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the distribution channel across enterprise systems including Sabre SynXis CRS, Oracle OPERA PMS, and IDeaS G3 RMS. Used for channel mapping and cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: commission_basis
attributes.description: The commercial model under which commission is calculated for this channel. NET_RATE = channel marks up a net rate provided by the property; GROSS_RATE = commission deducted from the gross rate charged to the guest; MARKUP = channel applies a markup over the property's net rate; FLAT_FEE = fixed fee per booking regardless of rate. Critical for accurate revenue and cost-of-acquisition reporting.

attributes.name: commission_rate_pct
attributes.description: Standard commission percentage charged by this distribution channel on each booking, expressed as a percentage of the room revenue (e.g., 15.00 for 15%). Drives cost-of-acquisition calculations and net revenue reporting per USALI standards. Confidential as it reflects negotiated commercial terms.

attributes.name: connectivity_fee_usd
attributes.description: Annual or periodic connectivity/subscription fee charged by the channel or switch provider for maintaining the technical integration, expressed in USD. Included in total cost-of-acquisition analysis alongside commission. Confidential as it reflects negotiated commercial terms.

attributes.name: connectivity_method
attributes.description: Technical integration method used to connect the property management system or CRS to this distribution channel. API = RESTful or SOAP API integration; XML = XML-based messaging (e.g., OTA XML); SFTP = file-based batch transfer; DIRECT_CONNECT = proprietary direct connection; SWITCH = via a channel manager switch (e.g., SiteMinder, Channex); MANUAL = manually managed extranet updates. Impacts SLA and rate update latency.

attributes.name: content_distribution_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether property content (room descriptions, images, amenities, policies) is actively distributed to this channel via a content API or content management system. True = content is pushed/synced to this channel; False = content is managed manually or not distributed. Relevant for OTA and metasearch channels.

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the commercial agreement with this distribution channel expires or is scheduled to terminate. Null for evergreen/open-ended agreements. Used for contract renewal management and channel lifecycle planning. Stored in yyyy-MM-dd format.

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the commercial agreement with this distribution channel became effective. Used for contract lifecycle management, commission audit trails, and regulatory compliance. Stored in yyyy-MM-dd format.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this distribution channel record was first created in the enterprise data platform. Stored in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and record lifecycle management.

attributes.name: crs_channel_code
attributes.description: Channel identifier as configured in the Sabre SynXis Central Reservation System (CRS). Used for cross-system reconciliation between the enterprise data lakehouse and the CRS source of record. Enables traceability of bookings back to the originating CRS channel configuration.

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this distribution channel was deactivated or decommissioned. Null for currently active channels. Used for channel lifecycle management, historical reporting, and audit trails. Stored in yyyy-MM-dd format.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the distribution channel, including its market positioning, target guest segment, special contractual terms, or operational notes. Used for channel management documentation and onboarding reference.

attributes.name: gdpr_data_processor
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Data Processor Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this distribution channel acts as a GDPR data processor for guest personal data collected during the booking process. True = a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) is in place with this channel; False = channel does not process personal data on behalf of the property. Required for GDPR compliance and data governance.

tag_set.value: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Data Processor Flag

attributes.name: gds_chain_code
attributes.description: Two-letter GDS chain code assigned to the hotel brand or property group within Global Distribution Systems (Sabre, Amadeus, Galileo/Travelport, Worldspan). Required for GDS-type channels to route availability and rate requests correctly. Null for non-GDS channels.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic reach of this distribution channel. GLOBAL = channel operates worldwide; REGIONAL = channel serves a specific geographic region (e.g., Asia-Pacific, Europe); DOMESTIC = channel serves a single country; LOCAL = channel serves a specific city or metro area. Used for channel mix strategy and market segmentation analysis.

attributes.name: inventory_allocation_method
attributes.description: Method by which room inventory is allocated to this distribution channel. POOLED = channel draws from the shared central inventory pool (real-time); ALLOTMENT = a fixed block of rooms is pre-allocated to the channel; FREE_SALE = channel can sell without prior allocation up to a defined limit; ON_REQUEST = bookings require manual confirmation. Managed in IDeaS G3 RMS and Sabre SynXis CRS.

attributes.name: last_room_availability
attributes.description: Indicates whether this channel has Last Room Availability (LRA) rights — meaning the property must make the last available room accessible through this channel at the contracted rate. LRA is a common contractual obligation in corporate and GDS agreements. True = LRA applies; False = LRA does not apply.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this distribution channel record was most recently modified in the enterprise data platform. Stored in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format. Used for change tracking, data freshness monitoring, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: loyalty_bookings_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether bookings made through this channel are eligible for loyalty program points accrual and redemption. True = loyalty points are awarded and redeemable; False = bookings through this channel do not qualify for loyalty benefits (common for opaque OTA channels). Managed in Salesforce CRM Loyalty Management.

attributes.name: mice_bookings_supported
attributes.business_glossary_term: Meetings Incentives Conferences Exhibitions (MICE) Bookings Supported Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this distribution channel supports group and MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, Exhibitions) bookings in addition to transient reservations. True = MICE/group bookings can be sourced through this channel; False = transient bookings only. Relevant for event sales and Delphi by Amadeus integration.

tag_set.value: Meetings Incentives Conferences Exhibitions (MICE) Bookings Supported Flag

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the distribution channel (e.g., 'Expedia Partner Central', 'Booking.com Extranet', 'Sabre GDS', 'Direct Web', 'Voice Reservations'). Used in reporting, dashboards, and channel mix analysis.

attributes.name: nrr_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether Non-Refundable Rate (NRR) products are distributed through this channel. True = NRR fences are available on this channel; False = only flexible/refundable rates are distributed. Impacts revenue management yield strategy and cancellation policy enforcement.

attributes.name: payment_model
attributes.description: Defines who collects payment from the guest for bookings made through this channel. HOTEL_COLLECT = property collects payment directly at check-in/check-out; CHANNEL_COLLECT = the OTA or intermediary collects payment and remits net to the property; SPLIT = partial payment collected by each party. Impacts accounts receivable and revenue recognition per USALI and GAAP/IFRS.

attributes.name: pci_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this distribution channel is certified as compliant with PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard) for handling cardholder data. True = channel holds current PCI DSS certification; False = channel is not PCI compliant or certification has lapsed. Required for risk management and payment security governance.

attributes.name: primary_market_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the primary market served by this distribution channel (e.g., 'USA', 'GBR', 'DEU'). Used for geographic channel mix analysis, market penetration reporting, and regulatory compliance (e.g., GDPR for EU-based channels).

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric rank indicating the strategic priority of this channel in the distribution mix, where lower numbers indicate higher priority (e.g., 1 = highest priority, typically direct web). Used by revenue management to determine inventory release sequencing and rate strategy. Configured in IDeaS G3 RMS and Sabre SynXis CRS.

attributes.name: rate_parity_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this distribution channel contractually requires rate parity — i.e., the property must offer the same or lower rates on this channel as on any other channel. True = rate parity clause is active in the channel agreement; False = no rate parity obligation. Critical for revenue management compliance and rate strategy.

attributes.name: rate_parity_type
attributes.description: Specifies the scope of the rate parity obligation for this channel. BROAD = property must match rates across all channels including direct; NARROW = property must match rates on other OTAs but may offer lower rates on direct channels (common post-EU regulatory changes); NONE = no rate parity obligation. Drives revenue management and direct booking strategy.

attributes.name: remittance_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the channel remits collected payments to the property for CHANNEL_COLLECT payment model bookings. Applicable only when payment_model is CHANNEL_COLLECT or SPLIT. Drives accounts receivable forecasting and cash flow management in SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: sla_response_time_seconds
attributes.business_glossary_term: Channel Service Level Agreement (SLA) Response Time (Seconds)
attributes.description: Maximum allowable response time in seconds for availability and rate queries from this channel, as defined in the channel's Service Level Agreement (SLA). Used to monitor channel connectivity performance and enforce SLA compliance. Typical values: 3 seconds for OTA/GDS, 5 seconds for XML channels.

tag_set.value: Channel Service Level Agreement (SLA) Response Time (Seconds)

attributes.name: sla_uptime_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Channel Service Level Agreement (SLA) Uptime Percentage
attributes.description: Contractually committed uptime percentage for this channel's connectivity, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 99.90 for 99.9% uptime). Used to monitor channel reliability and enforce SLA penalties. Managed against actual uptime metrics in channel performance reporting.

tag_set.value: Channel Service Level Agreement (SLA) Uptime Percentage

attributes.name: supported_currencies
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 4217 three-letter currency codes supported by this distribution channel for booking and payment (e.g., 'USD,EUR,GBP,JPY'). Relevant for multi-currency rate distribution and foreign exchange management. Managed in Sabre SynXis CRS.

attributes.name: supported_languages
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 639-1 two-letter language codes supported by this channel for content display and guest communication (e.g., 'en,fr,de,zh,ja'). Relevant for content localization strategy and international market reach.

products.name: ota_partner
